verdict.rationale: BILL S&E says every card transaction is categorized. It manages budgets and transactions through the API, and it sends real-time S&E event webhooks. Together these suggest same-day transaction data is available, but there is no evidence of a founder-facing real-time spend view broken down by team, category, and merchant; an API/webhook pipeline is a builder's workaround, not that view. Missing for 10: a documented real-time spend dashboard, breakdowns by team/budget and merchant, explicit same-day posting of card transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
